result.stdout:
Description:
  inspect and drive a CuiSharp app, and read its rules offline.

Usage:
  dotnet-cui [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information
  --version       Show version information

Commands:
  print, tree                 the controls the last frame drew, nested
  layout                      layout rectangles, observed union bounds and overflow diagnostics
  focus                       report that the window has focus (needed before typing)
  faults                      what the app threw while drawing, if anything
  quit                        close the app, or a live attached window
  find <text>                 one control: kind, label and rectangle
  click <text>                click a control, then print the frame it produced
  type <text>                 type into the focused control, then print the frame
  key <name>                  press a key by the name a person would use
  move <x> <y>                put the pointer somewhere without clicking (hover, tooltips)
  wheel <x> <y> <dy> <dx>     scroll at a point, in wheel notches (negative dy scrolls down)
  frame <count>               draw more frames, then print the tree
  pulse <count>               draw frames without printing the tree (answers: count, heap bytes)
  wait <seconds>              keep drawing until a frame marks itself ready (ui.MarkReady)
  waittext <seconds> <query>  keep drawing until a frame draws this text or query
  png <path>                  save the last frame as a PNG
  dwell <seconds>             keep the app drawing, then answer with one STATS line
  session                     read one protocol command per line from stdin or --script, against one build and one app: `dotnet cui session --script commands.txt`
  ps                          list running live CuiSharp windows (started with --live)
  api <name>                  one declaration from the API catalog inside this tool, offline
  icons <filter>              every icon constant: name, code point, and the literal to paste
  docs    
[truncated]

result.stdout:
Description:
  the controls the last frame drew, nested

Usage:
  dotnet-cui tree [options]

Options:
  -p, --project <path>      the app to drive: a directory, a .csproj, or a file-based .cs app (default: here)
  --app <exe>               drive a published build instead of building one
  -f, --framework <tfm>     the target framework, when the project has more than one
  --no-build                reuse the last build of the project instead of rebuilding it
  -a, --attach <pid|title>  drive a running live window (started with --live) over its named pipe; the value is its pid or title, or leave it out when only one window is open
  --size <WxH>              headless viewport as WxH, e.g. 420x720
  --env <KEY=VALUE>         set KEY=VALUE for the app; repeat it for several variables
  --state <dir>             app state root; sets CUISHARP_STATE_HOME for this run
  --frames <count>          draw this many frames before the command runs
  --wait <ready>            precondition: draw until a frame marks itself ready (ui.MarkReady)
  --wait-text <text>        precondition: draw until a frame draws this text or query
  --wait-timeout <seconds>  the window for --wait and --wait-text, in seconds (default 10, max 3600)
  -q, --quiet               print only the payload, never the tool's own progress
  --details                 include role, automation id, value and state in the tree
  -?, -h, --help            Show help and usage information
